legal.terms1: Home Ready is a free education programme from Potential.org, the nonprofit arm of Potential.com. It helps people in the UAE make better decisions about renting or buying a home.
legal.terms2: Home Ready is education, not legal, financial or mortgage advice. For your own case, speak to a qualified adviser. We never recommend specific properties, agents, banks or developers.
legal.terms3: Every fee and rule we show has an official source and the date we checked it. Rules change, so check the source before you act.
legal.terms4: You must be 18 or older. Keep your password private and use the programme for your own learning.
legal.privacy1: We collect your name, email, emirate, what brings you here, your preferred language and, if you give it, your UAE mobile number.
legal.privacy2: We use these details to run your account, save your checklists and results, and send the reminders you set.
legal.privacy3: Marketing emails stay off unless you tick the box. You can change this any time in your profile.
legal.privacy4: We never share your details with sponsors or partners without your separate yes for each request.
legal.guidelines1: Sponsors help keep Home Ready free. They never change or approve our content.
legal.guidelines2: Every sponsored placement carries the "Sponsored" label at its top-start corner.
legal.guidelines3: Sponsors see aggregate figures only. No personal data is shared without a learner's separate consent for each request.
